meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后，NanoClaw 启动容器时直接从 .env 读取 Anthropic 凭证（API 密钥或 OAuth 令牌，可含自定义端点），以环境变量形式注入容器，不再经过 OneCLI 网关。未设置标志时无任何变化。
howto.when: 当 .env 中设置 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 且存在 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY、ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 或 CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN 任一凭证时，容器启动就会注入；否则该技能不生效。

say.text: 我想用 Claude 订阅，请走原生凭证代理。
把 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 从 .env 注入到容器里。

howto.what_en: When enabled, NanoClaw reads Anthropic credentials (API key or OAuth token, optionally a custom base URL) from .env and injects them into the container as environment variables at startup, bypassing the OneCLI gateway. Without the flag, behavior is unchanged.
howto.when_en: Triggers when NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and at least one of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is present in .env, at container build time. Otherwise it is a no-op.

say_en.text: Enable use-native-credential-proxy and use Anthropic credentials from .env.
say_en.note: Applies the skill and configures .env injection.

say_en.text: I want to use my Claude subscription, set up the native credential proxy.
say_en.note: Walks you through running claude setup-token.

say_en.text: Inject ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env into the container.
say_en.note: Sets the flag and writes the key to .env.
